# Einstieg

## Ziele

- PHBern slide types distinguish instructional intent.
- Speaker notes separate facilitation from visible content.
- Bundled illustrations support consistent visual language.

# Wissenschaftliche Einordnung

## Multimedia Learning {.science}

Multimedia learning is not the accumulation of media. Text, image, and
explanation should support the learner's selection, organization, and
integration of information [@mayer2021].

## Kernaussage

::: {.center-quote}
Gestaltung folgt der didaktischen Absicht.
:::

## Schrittweise Argumentation

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="1"}
First identify the learning objective.
:::

::: {.fragment .center-quote data-fragment-index="2"}
Then choose the smallest useful media combination.
:::

::: {.notes}
Advance once for the first statement and a second time for the centred
quotation.
:::
